summary: No held thesis was broken by news today. DPZ, IDXX, VOO and WMT were all bought on 10-20 and show roughly flat P/L (-$0.04 on the day), and none had an 8-K or company-specific negative headline in the 72h window. DPZ's only recent filings were the 10-13 results (8-K 2.02 plus 10-Q), already known when it was bought. WMT's headlines (Deutsche Bank upgrade, Evercore PT raise to $130, BofA Buy, the $120 Walmart+/Sam's Club bundle) were all positive, which supports the Skeptic's worry that the upgrades were priced in by the time of the 17:28Z fill; WMT was the only holding down on the day (-0.5%). The tape was mostly macro and AI-rotation commentary (Burry, a data-center selloff, Qualcomm layoffs) that bears on the tech-rotation context but not on the four holdings. Note: inputs/learning.json was not present in the run directory, so no lessons, graded calls or news_memory were applied.
